BrochureContent.Content:
A Charming Property Set in The Most Picturesque Countryside 

Ard Choille is a charming cottage enjoying an elevated setting in the picturesque and historic village of St. Mullins, one of County Carlow's most sought-after locations, beautifully framed by the River Barrow and the Blackstairs Mountains. Full of character and potential, the property has been carefully stripped back, providing a blank canvas for purchasers to restore and reimagine. Eligible for the Property Refurbishment Grants (subject to the relevant terms and conditions). The property comprises an attractive cut-stone cottage with a later extension, extending to approximately 114 sq m, and commands breathtaking views across the surrounding countryside from its elevated position. St. Mullins is celebrated for its heritage, scenic riverside setting and exceptional outdoor pursuits. The renowned Mullicháin Café, Heron Sauna and Blanchfield's Bar are all within walking distance, while The Barrow Way provides miles of walking and cycling trails alongside opportunities for boating, kayaking and fishing on the River Barrow. The nearby towns of Graiguenamanagh, Borris, with its popular weekly farmers' market, and New Ross offer an excellent range of shops, schools, restaurants and everyday amenities, making this an idyllic location in which to enjoy country living. Combining timeless character, exceptional potential and an enviable village setting, Ard Choille offers a unique opportunity to create a truly special home in one of the South East's most picturesque locations
